speech.text:
Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!{FB}Welcome to the world of POKéMON!{FB}My name is BIRCH.{FB}But everyone calls me the POKéMON
PROFESSOR.{FB}

This world is widely inhabited by
creatures known as POKéMON.{FB}We humans live alongside POKéMON,
at times as friendly playmates, and{FA}at times as cooperative workmates.{FB}And sometimes, we band together
and battle others like us.{FB}But despite our closeness, we don’t
know everything about POKéMON.{FB}In fact, there are many, many
secrets surrounding POKéMON.{FB}To unravel POKéMON mysteries,
I’ve been undertaking research.{FA}That’s what I do.{FB}

Are you a boy?
Or are you a girl?

Ah, okay!{FB}You’re {FD}{01}{FD}{05} who’s moving to my
hometown of LITTLEROOT.{FA}I get it now!{FB}

All right, are you ready?{FB}Your very own adventure is about
to unfold.{FB}Take courage, and leap into the
world of POKéMON where dreams,{FA}adventure, and friendships await!{FB}Well, I’ll be expecting you later.
Come see me in my POKéMON LAB.{FB}

notes: Discovered and verified by tools/gen3_discover.py; re-run it rather than hand-editing an address.
Species numbering is INTERNAL, not National Dex: 1-251 agree, 252-276 are 25 unused slots, Hoenn runs 277-411.
The graphics tables are 440 rows (Unown forms); the name table is 412.
symbolSource: structural discovery against the cartridge itself (tools/gen3_discover.py); a retail GBA ROM ships no symbol table, so every address here is found by shape and verified against a fact the table must satisfy
